title: Wire MESA-QA to official MESA validation mode
notes: MESA-QA now selects MESA's official validation mode through mesa.validation_mode without implementing its own shadow validator policy.
Mode 0 propagates MESA_TIER3_MODE='0' and disables LLM validator construction in candidate runtime.
Mode 1 propagates MESA_TIER3_MODE='1' with validator A.
Mode 2 propagates MESA_TIER3_MODE='2' with validators A and B.
Invalid validation mode inputs fail explicitly on validation.
Lite profile enforces Mode 0 and disables external paid providers.
